thread.title: Qualcomm Accuses Apple Of Stealing Trade Secrets To Give To Intel | Investor's Business Daily

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Qualcomm Accuses Apple Of Stealing Trade Secrets To Give To Intel | Investor's Business Daily
text:
The legal battle between Qualcomm ( QCOM ) and Apple ( AAPL ) escalated Tuesday. The wireless chip company now is accusing the iPhone maker of stealing its trade secrets and giving them to rival Intel ( INTC ).
X Qualcomm made the accusation in a motion to amend a lawsuit that it filed in November, Reuters reported . In the original complaint, Qualcomm alleged that Apple had broken a software license contract by sharing confidential details about Qualcomm's chips with Intel engineers.
Qualcomm believes Apple gave trade secrets to Intel to help it develop communications chips to replace Qualcomm in the iPhone. The current iPhone XS series phones are the first to rely on Intel modems instead of Qualcomm chips. Those 12th-generation handsets went on sale on Friday. Intel became a second supplier of modem chips to Apple starting with the iPhone 7.
"Apple has engaged in a yearslong campaign of false promises, stealth, and subterfuge designed to steal Qualcomm's confidential information and trade secrets for the purpose of improving the performance and accelerating the time to market of lower-quality modem chips, including those developed by Intel," Qualcomm said in the latest court filing. "Apple used that stolen technology to divert Qualcomm's Apple-based business to Intel."

The case is scheduled to go to trial next April in California Superior Court, San Diego County, Bloomberg reported .
Qualcomm says it gave software and tools to Apple with strict restrictions on their use, but Apple shared the technology with Intel.
Apple and Qualcomm are locked in a protracted legal fight over patent-licensing terms and royalty rates for Qualcomm's technology. The iPhone maker is withholding royalty payments to Qualcomm until they settle their numerous suits and countersuits.
Apple stock rose 0.6% to close at 22.19 on the stock market today . Qualcomm shares fell 1.1% to close at 72.74.
